description: This file provides assertion methods for testing PropertySearchFilter objects within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods to assert properties like path and values.

classes.name: PropertySearchFilterAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for PropertySearchFilter objects, extending SearchFilterAssert, providing methods to validate filter path and values.

methods.name: PropertySearchFilterAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion with the actual PropertySearchFilter object.

methods.name: hasPath
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has the expected JSON pointer path.

methods.name: hasNoValue
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has no associated values.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter contains only the specified JSON values.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue
methods.description: Overloaded method: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter contains only the specified string values.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue
